profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary: I'm passionate about understanding how things work, solving complex problems, and making a positive impact.  From a technical standpoint, I'm particularly interested in low-level software development, software reverse engineering, and contributing to open source projects.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: - Currently working on using AI to find vulnerabilities in Chrome (and beyond!)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

positions.title: Malware Research Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed new features for an automated antivirus signature generation system (using Python, Django, Celery, and Docker)
- Reverse-engineered malware to write detection content (ClamAV, Yara, Snort, etc.) and develop related software, including file decryptors, config extractors, and tools for automated analysis
- Analyzed malware sandbox runs to write behavioral signatures for techniques leveraged (persistence, privilege escalation, etc.) and for unique behavior that can be used to tie a file back to a known malware family
- Wrote test programs/scripts (using C/C++, .NET, and Powershell) to exercise various Windows APIs and identify indicators related to built-in system functionality
- Automated detection content research, generation, validation, and testing via scripting (in Python)
- Contributed bug fixes and improvements to ClamAV (in C) and other malware-related open-source projects

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: - Analyzed network device configurations to identify potential vulnerabilities and ensure secure system operations

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: - Analyzed Android operating system internals and developed applications in Java

positions.title: CDO Choice Intern
positions.description: - Developed a web application to track VoIP phone testbed configurations and wrote scripts to provision Cisco CallManager servers

positions.title: CDO Choice Intern
positions.description: - Developed Perl scripts to parse and analyze processor-level router simulation data to facilitate performance optimization
